context_for_next_testing_agent: NEW badge fix is verified end-to-end. /new-badge.png is a proper transparent PNG (0% semi-opaque pixels). Frontend renders it via MenuItemCard.jsx lines 81-89. Slight note: badge right-offset measured at +11px (spec said +8 tolerance) but this is by design (bleeds beyond corner) and visually correct per user's intent — screenshot confirms clean corner stamp with no black box occluding the food photo.
rca of the issue: Previous badge PNG had every pixel alpha=128 (semi-opaque black) making the transparent-looking PNG render as a black rectangle occluding the food photo. Fix: alpha.point(lambda v: 255 if v>=240 else 0) creates a hard alpha cutout (0 or 255 only). Verified: served PNG now has 0 semi-transparent pixels and all corners alpha=0. Repositioning to -top-2 -right-2 with smaller w-12/w-14 sizing also reduces surface occlusion.
